name: SKP Resources Bhd
overview: 2026年，SKP Resources Bhd 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。公司仅发布了季度业绩、股东大会通知、年报及股息除权等常规公告。
overview_en: In 2026, SKP Resources Bhd did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements. The company only released routine announcements such as quarterly results, general meeting notices, annual report, and dividend ex-date.
